shellCommands.command: ls /workspace && echo "---PKG---" && cat /workspace/package.json && echo "---DOCS---" && ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -50
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -ril "view-transition\|viewTransition\|ViewTransition" . | head -30
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides && wc -l view-transitions.md interactive-apps.md && echo "=====VT=====" && cat view-transitions.md
cd /workspace && find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head -60 && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components && grep -n -A 40 "transitionTypes" link.md | head -80
cd /workspace && for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx" lib/products.ts; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done
echo "=====globals.css=====" && cat app/globals.css && echo "=====eval=====" && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading && grep -n -i -B3 -A12 "view.transition\|viewTransition" version-16.md | head -60

cd /workspace && node -e "console.log('@types/react:', require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version)" && grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20; echo "--- next-provided types? ---"; grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/*.d.ts node_modules/next/*.d.ts node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- tsconfig ---"; cat tsconfig.json
ls node_modules/@types/react/ && echo "--- grep all ---" && grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/ | head -20
sed -n '1,45p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts && echo "..." && grep -n "share\|const ViewTransition\|ViewTransition:" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head -20
grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "react/canary\|next-env.d.ts" node_modules/next/dist/lib/typescript/writeAppTypeDeclarations.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- content template ---"; cat node_modules/next/dist/lib/typescript/writeAppTypeDeclarations.js 2>/dev/null | head -40
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3111 >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf http://localhost:3111/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.5; done; echo "=== / grid card ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o '<div class="product-grid">.\{0,400\}'; echo; echo "=== /product/classic-sneakers detail ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<div class="product-detail">.\{0,500\}'

echo "=== home: product-card ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o 'product-grid.\{0,600\}'; echo; echo "=== home: main/vt attrs ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o '<main[^>]*>'; echo "=== detail: streamed-in content (enter attrs) ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'vt-enter="[^"]*"' | sort -u; echo "=== detail: outer page wrapper ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'vt-enter-[^ >]*\|<div vt[^>]*>' | head

echo "=== flight payload: page-level ViewTransition props ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '"enter":{[^}]*}' | head -3; echo "---exit---"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '"exit":{[^}]*}' | head -3; echo "=== back-link transitionTypes ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'transitionTypes[^]]*]' | head -3
curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'enter[^,]\{0,120\}' | head -5; echo "=== home ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o 'enter\\\\\?":.\{0,160\}' | head -5

ls /root/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome chrome 2>/dev/null; node -e "try{require.resolve('playwright');console.log('playwright ok')}catch{console.log('no playwright')}"; node -e "try{require.resolve('puppeteer');console.log('puppeteer ok')}catch{console.log('no puppeteer')}"
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; echo "=== git status ===" && git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json && echo "=== untracked new files ===" && ls next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null
rm -rf .next && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20 && echo "=== tsconfig untouched? ===" && git diff --stat tsconfig.json
rm -rf .next && git status --short
